front.title: An SVCB Service Parameter for Well-Known URI Paths

abstract.t: This document defines the "well-known" Service Parameter Key (SvcParamKey) for SVCB and HTTPS resource records. It carries one or more well-known URI suffixes, identifying resources under "/.well- known/" that are available at the service endpoint. It specifies the presentation and wire formats and requests registration of the key with IANA.
